paper_title: Causal Associations Between the Gut Microbiome and Aortic Aneurysm: A Mendelian Randomization Study
study_design: Two-sample Mendelian randomization of public microbial-trait and aneurysm GWAS summary statistics.
evidence_type: Genetic-instrument association estimates under MR assumptions, with alternative estimator comparisons.
claim: The study paired microbial genetic instruments with separate AA and AAA outcome summary statistics.
context: Methods report SNP selection at P<1×10−5, exclusion of F<10 instruments, and LD clumping at r²=0.001 across 10,000 kb. These are reported criteria; instrument rows and exposure–outcome sample overlap were not independently verified.
reported_evidence: [{"label":"Exposure source","value":"MiBioGen: 18,473 participants, 24 multi-ethnic cohorts"},{"label":"AA cases / controls","value":"7,395 / 349,539"},{"label":"AAA cases","value":"3,548"},{"label":"Reported SNP entries","value":"2,031"}]
source_locator: Methods: Data Source for Gut Microbiota; Data Source for Outcomes; Selection of Instrumental Variables. Results: Selection of Instrumental Variables for Gut Microbiomes. https://www.scienceopen.com/hosted-document?doi=10.15212/CVIA.2024.0023
scope_does_not_establish: ["Benefits from changing the microbiome, probiotics, antibiotics or aneurysm-prevention treatment.","A validated screening biomarker, patient-level risk score or clinical threshold.","Proof of absent pleiotropy, valid instruments, or independently reproduced supplementary sensitivity and full multiple-testing results.","A resolved TAA endpoint definition or reconciled screen-wide microbial-taxon count."]
limitations: ["The TAA Methods definition uses thoracoabdominal rather than thoracic outcomes; TAA-specific findings are excluded pending clarification.","The retained-taxon total is stated as 196, while Results category counts sum to 195; neither is presented as a reconciled screen-wide count.","Bonferroni correction is described by taxonomic level, but equation images and supplements were unavailable. Main-table estimates are reported as author-selected associations, not an independently reproduced screen-wide significance claim.","Alternative estimator intervals do not uniformly exclude the null; MR estimates remain assumption-dependent.","The exposure GWAS is multi-ethnic and the outcome source is Finnish. Portability, population structure and sample overlap require consideration; overlap was not quantified here.","Supplementary MR-PRESSO, Steiger, leave-one-out and instrument tables were not independently inspected. Non-significant diagnostic tests would not prove the absence of pleiotropy.","No intervention, prospective diagnostic validation or clinical treatment benefit was tested."]
